question: The popular dance 'Laho' is related to which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __Meghalaya__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Laho dance belongs to the state of Meghalaya __in India.
 
• It is performed during the Behdienkhlam festival.
 
• It is performed by both men and women.
 
• Jaintia tribe perform this dance festival.
